text_block_list.text:
Ah, is it that time already? Спешл Уик,
I'm heading—
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Inhale... exhale... All righty! SUZUKA!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Y-yes?!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Is it okay if I go running with you?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Sure! ...Huh?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
All righty! All done stretching! Let's hurry
up and run, Suzuka!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Seeing as we're here together, why don't
we do partner running? Let's
treat it like a
real race and give it our all!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: A race...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Suzuka, does starting off with a
1,600-meter left-handed race sound

good? I'll go prepare!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Ah, o-okay...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Okay then, then let's do this! Ready, set...
GO!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Huh? Whoa?! She's already way ahead!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
(It's just me on the track. No one else in
sight, and all I can hear is my
feet quietly
hitting the ground... My favorite things...)
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
(Then... what's the point of racing? I could
just run by myself
forever...)
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: (Why am I... racing?)
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Suzuka! Coming to Академия Тайсен and
being able to race with you
has made me
so happy!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: That's why... I won't lose! Yaaaaah!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Ah! No way, she passed me...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: (No. The lead is... my spot!)
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Haaah!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Whoa, Suzuka! Well, I'm not finished yet!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
(She's not backing down! If I don't keep
focused, she could turn this
around!)
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: But I won't... I won't give up my lead!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Waaah?!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: ...Not yet! Not yeeeeet!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Hehe!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff...
text_block_list.name: Suzuka and Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Phew... Wow, we really ran a lot!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Yeah... We certainly gave it our all.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Suzuka? Um, are you okay? It seems like
something's wrong.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Ah... No, I was just... admiring the view.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
(How silly of me. What was I so worried
about?)
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
First across the finish is Сайленс Судзука!
That's Сайленс Судзука,
showing off her
splendid front running!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... pant...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
(Competing with everything I have,
pushing my limits to make it to
the end...)
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: This is... the view from the lead!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
(Thank you for reminding me... my new
friend.)
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
You know, Suzuka, you're craaaaazy fast!
I'm gonna have to train a lot
more! I'm so
pumped!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Um...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Ah, yeah? What is it?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Um... Is it all right if I call you Spe?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh... Yeah! Yeah, of course!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: You two!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Aaaaah?!
Waaaah?!
text_block_list.name: Suzuka and Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
What are you doing out at a time like this!
It's way past curfew! Get
back to your
dorms now! Move those feet!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Y-yes, ma'am!
text_block_list.name: Suzuka and Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Hmph. What a handful...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Dear Mom and Mama, student life is way
rougher than I thought it
would be.
Everyone's so fast, lessons are difficult,
and I'm very busy.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
But... I have a dream that I intend to make
reality.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Because of that, everything is okay! I'm
going to do my best, together
with my
friends and classmates!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Someday I'll make my debut, appear in the
Twinkle Series... and then
make my dream
come true!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
I'll make you both proud! Love, Special
Week.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик
